IAEA public pages remained Cloudflare-blocked; Saudi civilian-nuclear coverage did not establish an Iranian technical threshold. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: BBC reports the second reciprocal no-strike night was intended to give diplomacy more time; U.S. Ambassador Mike Waltz said all options remain open. Iran-Oman technical talks over Hormuz management continue, while the U.S. blockade and restricted nonzero transit remain in force. The unverified mine report still lacks a named vessel. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.notes: U.S.-supported direct talks remain active. Lebanese and Al-Ahed-linked reporting described continued Israeli air, drone and artillery activity in the south earlier on 26 July, but the post-18Z review found no independently verified new casualty or strategic territorial change. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The full rolling-day Google/Bing and direct-page review found no verified Turkish combat entry, unusual regional force concentration, official nuclear-doctrine shift or new missile-range event. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Kargil-anniversary rhetoric and unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir did not produce a verified interstate strike, Line of Control exchange or unusual force concentration in the reviewed window. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified fresh interstate border strike, sustained state-on-state clash or current crossing closure appeared. A Google RSS item claiming a fourth day of Torkham closure was opened directly and excluded because its article body is dated 25 February 2025. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Current reporting remains at two deaths in Ukraine from Russian attacks and four in Russian-held territory from Ukrainian drones. Iran has threatened an unspecified answer over the Caspian vessel strike, but no Iranian retaliatory strike on Ukraine or new nuclear-posture threshold appeared. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania's third suspected Russian-drone shootdown in three days and ambassador summons remain the key allied threshold. NATO's official news page still showed no Article 4/5 consultation or alliance-wide posture announcement through the 21Z check. Raw 56; coupled 66

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new PLA quarantine, blockade declaration, amphibious concentration or cross-Strait clash appeared. A China-Russia naval-patrol report added no Taiwan operational threshold. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Zelensky's claim that Russia seeks 30,000 additional DPRK troops remains without independent deployment evidence. No current missile launch or nuclear test appeared. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: SAF newly claimed Umm Qarfa and Juraikh and full control of the Omdurman-El Obeid export highway. The carrying outlet explicitly said the military statement was not independently verified; no RSF response or independent capture confirmation was found, so the score does not rise. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Israel's approved framework for limited international-force entry into Gaza remains the concrete political step, while AP reporting on two burned West Bank mosques and continuing settler violence reinforces that implementation has not produced a ceasefire. No additional numeric move is justified. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or Abyei security shift appeared in the rolling-day exact and fallback lanes. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh strategic M23 capture, mass recruitment announcement or direct Rwanda-DRC clash appeared. Earlier South Kivu fighting remains the latest qualifying evidence. Raw 56; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.notes: Houthi-Saudi missile and drone exchanges remain confirmed.
